description: Safety report for a token before the user buys or receives it: honeypot (can't sell), buy/sell/transfer taxes, owner powers (mint, blacklist, pause, freeze), unpublished code, few holders, and fake majors (a token calling itself USDC/ETH/SOL at the wrong address). level is ok, caution, danger or unknown (no source answered; never block a swap on unknown alone). On danger, warn the user and get explicit confirmation before get_quote. Read-only.

chain.description: The token's chain: slug ("base", "solana", "ethereum", "arbitrum"...) or numeric chain id (Solana is 7565164). See list_chains.

token.description: The token to check: symbol or token: symbol from list_tokens ("USDC", "ETH", "SOL") or the token contract address / SPL mint. Use "native" for the chain's gas coin.

name: get_token_risk
title: Check a token for risks
